passage.label: not commanded except worship Allah sincere religion inclining truth establish prayer give zakah correct religion

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ

mainSubject.label: They were commanded only to worship Allah sincerely in religion, inclining to truth, establishing prayer and giving zakah — that being the correct religion

subordinateSubjects.label: Commanded only to worship Allah sincerely, inclining to truth, establishing prayer and giving zakah — the correct religion

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Pure religion defined as sincere worship, truth-inclination, prayer and zakah

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the division-after-evidence statement (4) before the pure-worship command opens (5); P2 is the single-verse definition of correct religion (5); P3 runs through the worst-versus-best binary and the closing mutual-pleasure reward (6-8).
